## About this round

Afreximbank's investment vehicle CANEX Creations Incorporated has acquired an equity stake in CREAM, per Premium Times (13 Nov 2026). Term sheet signed Abuja June 2025; formalised at a signing ceremony on 6 Nov 2026 during CANEX WKND 2026, Lagos. Amount, valuation, lead status and primary/secondary split are not disclosed in the source; lead not stated so is\_lead false. Undisclosed amount, not added to any capital total.
